'''Matt Sokol Hunt down = beat down''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Matt Sokol]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-972">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/972 Hunt down = beat down], DeckTech (Matt "MattSokol" Sokol, 24 October 1999). == Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matt Sokol]]
* '''Published:''' 24 October 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hunt down = beat down''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Sokol DS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This hunt down deck is used to go beatthe opp. down. it can take on almost anydeck, and do well.

== Original post ==

'''Hunt down = beat down'''
* '''Author:''' Matt "MattSokol" Sokol
* '''Published:''' October 24, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This hunt down deck is used to go beatthe opp. down. it can take on almost anydeck, and do well.

=== Strategy ===

The way i see it dark side is lagging right now. light side has so many good deck themes, that it makes it hard for the dark side to win. this can't win all of it's games but i have about 2 out of three with it. It has lots of high destiny that you can track.. playing six vader's is always cool also. It has trouble beating opp's and rev/nudj, but whatever. it is a good beat down deck that is cool to play.
